verdict.rationale: QuickBooks docs confirm custom user roles/permissions and explicitly mention giving accountants direct access to books, supporting the core story, but there's no detailed evidence of a dedicated accountant-invite workflow with granular scoped permissions (e.g., limiting to specific accounts or read vs. adjust rights) beyond general role-based access. missing for 10: dedicated accountant-invite flow details, granular scope-limiting controls specific to bookkeeper review/adjust tasks, independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
